repository_intelligence.purpose: Browser-tool specification and explainers for JavaScript registration, declarative HTML form tools and proposed service-worker providers; not a browser or MCP server implementation.
repository_intelligence.reuse_recommendation: Reference when designing browser-native tools; verify current target-browser support and implementation-specific security.
repository_intelligence.inspection_scope: Bounded pinned README/manifest/tree and relevant source review; deeper components, security and runtime verification are demand-driven. Detailed asset records remain unchanged.
